title: LRU Cache
problemStatement: Design and implement an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache that supports the following operations in O(1) average time: get(key) put(key, value) If the cache reaches its capacity, evict the least recently used item before inserting a new one. Process a sequence of operations and print the result of every get() operation.
input: Integer capacity Integer q Next q operations
output: Print the result of every get() operation.
